summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper, using only os and json. Exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Per instructions, I did not run tests, black, or flake8, and did not commit. Line lengths were checked by measurement: none exceed 120. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list data_list_key value and a non-object top-level JSON value both raise ValueError; malformed JSON propagates as json.JSONDecodeError, which is a ValueError subclass.
